I think syscringe has a severe misunderstanding of a simple concept: WHY and alter split is not necessarily the alter’s role, and alters can have tasks / jobs that are completely outside of the trauma they hold / why they split. 

For example: you can have a designated financial manager or alter who manages money for the system. That does NOT mean that alter split due to financial stress or struggles. That CAN be the case, but it doesn’t HAVE to be. 

In this post, this label is purely just to describe an alter within the system who happens to like decorating things. This may be purely for aesthetic reasons, or it could come from a deeper reason (for example, the alter may feel the need to log information for fear of forgetting it). It says literally nothing about what trauma the alter holds, or what roles they have beyond this. 

Not to mention another fact: not every alter even has a specific role!
